label: Queue worker
description: What works this tree's queues. A project's startup list names `consume` to start it: nothing consumes a queue on its own, so a tree that does not ask to work its queues does not. The queues are the queue triggers themselves -- this operation names none of them.

consume.description: Consume every queue a queue trigger of this tree receives from until the process stops: each message fires its trigger's operation, gated like a request, and is acknowledged, retried or dead-lettered as the trigger's outcomes say. Stopping takes no further message and waits for every one in flight to be answered. Answers what it started, so a startup report says how many queues on how many connections.

concurrency.description: how many messages of one queue run at once, a whole number of 1 or more; absent: 1

queues.description: the names of the queues this process works; absent: every queue a queue trigger receives from

connections.description: how many broker connections they are consumed on
